description: This file defines the ZipStream class which provides functionality for creating streamed, dynamically generated ZIP archives. It includes methods for adding files (by content, path, or stream), finishing the archive, and handling ZIP-specific headers and options.

classes.name: ZipStream\ZipStream
classes.description: A class for creating streamed ZIP archives with methods to add files, finish the archive, and manage ZIP-specific headers and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ZipStream object with optional filename and archive options, setting up internal state.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file to the zip archive using the file's name and data, with optional configuration options.

methods.name: addFileFromPath
methods.description: Adds a file to the archive from a local filesystem path, with optional configuration.

methods.name: addFileFromStream
methods.description: Adds a file from a stream resource to the archive.

methods.name: addFileFromPsr7Stream
methods.description: Adds a file from a PSR-7 stream to the archive.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the ZIP archive by writing necessary headers and footers to the stream.

methods.name: packFields
methods.description: Creates a packed binary string for ZIP headers based on field specifications.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Outputs data to the stream, sending HTTP headers if required.

methods.name: isLargeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file exceeds the configured large file size threshold.

methods.name: addToCdr
methods.description: Records file attributes for the central directory record.

methods.name: addCdr64Eof
methods.description: Outputs the ZIP64 central directory record end-of-file marker.

methods.name: sendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers for the ZIP archive download if configured.

methods.name: addCdr64Locator
methods.description: Outputs the ZIP64 central directory record locator.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal state after archive completion.
